title: Chic Corner Condo Escape with Seasonal Pool Access
description:
Stay in a stylish one-bedroom corner condo at Illume, close to The Gulch and downtown Nashville. The home sleeps up to four with one king bedroom and a sofa bed in the living room. Enjoy a full kitchen, dedicated workspace, in-building washer and dryer, elevator, gym, and access to the seasonal communal outdoor pool.

The space
Illume 319 is a single-level, one-bedroom corner condo for up to four guests. The bedroom has one king bed, and the living room has one sofa bed. The full kitchen includes a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, blender, toaster, and dishes and silverware. The condo also offers air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TVs, a dedicated workspace, and a private entrance. The washer and dryer are located in the building. Building amenities include an elevator, gym, and seasonal communal outdoor pool. Outdoor seating is also available. The property is close to The Gulch, downtown Nashville, museums, shopping, dining, and entertainment.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
